flipToBack.prose: Flip if the Effect 'Grievous Will Run And Hide' is attached to this Objective ('here'), UNLESS Grievous is alone at a battleground. The alone-exception is double-checked: it only blocks the flip when Grievous is alone even when counting battle-excluded characters (isAlone with SpotOverride.INCLUDE_EXCLUDED_FROM_BATTLE).

children.req: card-attached-to-objective: Grievous Will Run And Hide attached to self
card-spot: Grievous alone at a battleground (any battleground location, not just sites)
children.gameConditions: Filters.findFirstActive(game, self, Filters.and(Filters.Grievous, Filters.alone, Filters.at(Filters.battleground))) != null

flipToFront.prose: Back flips to front if Grievous Will Run And Hide is NOT attached to this Objective (wherever it went, including off-table), OR if Grievous is alone at a battleground (alone verified including battle-excluded).

children.req: card-attached-to-objective: Grievous Will Run And Hide attached to self
card-spot: Grievous alone at a battleground
children.gameConditions: Filters.findFirstActive(game, self, Filters.and(Filters.Grievous, Filters.alone, Filters.at(Filters.battleground))) != null

requirementSemantics: flipToBack: card-attached-to-objective semantics (GameConditions.hasAttached on self), a card-on-table/attachment state, NOT control/occupy/presence of any location.

Exception clause: opponent-persona state (Grievous alone at a battleground). Filters.battleground = any battleground location (site or system), not battleground_site. 'Alone' is re-verified with modifiersQuerying.isAlone(INCLUDE_EXCLUDED_FROM_BATTLE) so companions excluded from battle still break 'alone'.

flipToFront leg 1: NOT hasAttached(self, GWRAH). The code checks attachment to the Objective, NOT 'GWRAH at a battleground' as the card text reads; if GWRAH leaves the objective for any reason (moved to a battleground, or gone), the back flips to front.
flipToFront leg 2: same Grievous-alone-at-battleground state that blocks the front flip also actively flips the back to front.
Both sides' obligations use occupy-count comparisons (Filters.occupies(playerId)) for the end-of-opponent's-turn Force loss clock; the back's X uses occupiesWith [Clone Army]-icon cards.
typedIdentities: Filters.Grievous_Will_Run_And_Hide (the tracked Effect; attachment to self is the flip state)
Filters.Clone_Command_Center (deployed to same system as the chosen [Clone Army] battleground)
Filters.and(Filters.your(self), Filters.Jedi) + Icon.PILOT (icon grant, both sides)
Filters.and(Filters.your(self), Icon.EPISODE_I, Filters.site) immune to Title.No_Escape (both sides)

Back: Filters.and(Filters.your(self), Filters.clone, Filters.with(self, Filters.or(Filters.Jedi, Filters.padawan))) (drain +1); Filters.icon(Icon.CLONE_ARMY) (X count and retrieval); Filters.and(Filters.battleground, Filters.occupiesWith(playerId, self, Filters.icon(Icon.CLONE_ARMY))) (X definition)
setupAndPullRoutes: START OF GAME (front, required, chained): deploy a [Clone Army] battleground (Filters.and(Icon.CLONE_ARMY, Filters.battleground, Filters.location)); then in its cardDeployed callback deploy Clone Command Center to that battleground's SAME system (DeployCardToSystemFromReserveDeckEffect(Filters.Clone_Command_Center, systemName)); then deploy Cloning Cylinders (Filters.Cloning_Cylinders); then deploy Grievous Will Run And Hide (Filters.Grievous_Will_Run_And_Hide) [Card221_067.java:51-92]

BACK, on each battle YOU initiate: peek at top card of your Reserve Deck or Used Pile, optionally take into hand or bottom of Reserve Deck; then if X > 1 retrieve a [Clone Army] card into hand (RetrieveCardIntoHandEffect(Filters.icon(Icon.CLONE_ARMY)), isDueToInitiatingBattle=true); then if X > 2 may move one clone as a regular move using landspeed for free to the battle location. X = count of battlegrounds you occupy with [Clone Army]-icon cards (Variable.X adjustable) [Card221_067_BACK.java:94-165]
No generic Reserve Deck location/character downloads outside setup.
otherObligations: FRONT+BACK: owner may not deploy non-[Episode I] cards with ability: MayNotDeployModifier(Filters.and(Filters.not(Icon.EPISODE_I), Filters.hasAbilityOrHasPermanentPilotWithAbility), owner) [Card221_067.java:97, Card221_067_BACK.java:63]
FRONT+BACK: Your Destiny is suspended: SuspendsCardModifier(self, Filters.Your_Destiny) [Card221_067.java:98, Card221_067_BACK.java:64]
FRONT+BACK: [Reflections II] objectives target Anakin instead of Luke: ModifyGameTextModifier [Card221_067.java:99, Card221_067_BACK.java:65]
FRONT+BACK: your Jedi gain [Pilot] icon: IconModifier(Filters.and(Filters.your(self), Filters.Jedi), Icon.PILOT) [Card221_067.java:100, Card221_067_BACK.java:66]
FRONT+BACK: your [Episode I] sites immune to No Escape: ImmuneToTitleModifier [Card221_067.java:101, Card221_067_BACK.java:67]

FRONT+BACK Force-loss clock: at end of opponent's turn, if count of battlegrounds you occupy > count opponent occupies (Filters.filterTopLocationsOnTable(Filters.and(Filters.battleground, Filters.occupies(...)))), opponent loses 1 Force [Card221_067.java:112-123, Card221_067_BACK.java:79-90]

BACK: your Force drains +1 where you have a clone with a Jedi or Padawan: ForceDrainModifier(Filters.sameLocationAs(self, Filters.and(Filters.your(self), Filters.clone, Filters.with(self, Filters.or(Filters.Jedi, Filters.padawan)))), 1, owner) [Card221_067_BACK.java:68]
No hard-lose / place-out-of-play condition on either side.
seedMismatches: Seed flipBack leg 1 claims relation PRESENT 'Grievous Will Run And Hide at a battleground'; source checks !GameConditions.hasAttached(game, self, Filters.Grievous_Will_Run_And_Hide) (Card221_067_BACK.java:175): the back flips to front whenever GWRAH is no longer attached to the Objective, regardless of whether it is at a battleground. Code is strictly broader than the seed/card-text phrasing.

Seed omits the alone re-verification guard on both directions: Grievous only counts as 'alone' if modifiersQuerying.isAlone(..., SpotOverride.INCLUDE_EXCLUDED_FROM_BATTLE) also holds (companions excluded from battle still break 'alone').

profileGaps: requiredCardsOnTable and flipGateCardIds empty: the flip law's pivot is the Grievous Will Run And Hide Effect and its attachment location (on the Objective vs elsewhere); entirely unrepresented.
keyCharacterFilter is null: Filters.Grievous (opponent persona whose alone-at-battleground state blocks/reverses the flip) is unrepresented.
flipGateSite is null: correct in the sense the law has no gate site, but the profile also lacks any encoding of the attachment-state gate that replaces it.

pullableCards empty: the chained setup (Clone Army battleground -> Clone Command Center same planet -> Cloning Cylinders -> GWRAH) is not represented; only two locations appear as objectiveNamedLocations.

The deploy ban (non-[Episode I] cards with ability), the end-of-turn battleground-majority Force-loss clock, and the back's battle-initiation package (peek/retrieve/move keyed to X) have no representation.
